title: P15.9-B5.3: /app/missions* Mission Operations + Task Entry + Mission Detail (canonical reads)
description: P15.9-B5.3 R1+R2+R3 — R1: lineage provenance, preview epoch pinning, collection validation, identity-pinned mutations. R2: per-request busy slots, lineage evidence validation, strict preview task contract. R3-F1: the ACTIVE preview request owns previewBusy via previewReq{id,AbortController} — invalidation aborts the obsolete fetch and releases the UI lock immediately so a fresh preview B starts while A is unresolved; aborted/obsolete requests never render, commit, or clear a newer request's busy state; confirmation POSTs are separate (never aborted/forgotten — single-flight confirmFlight + honest unknown outcome on mid-flight input change); exact pinned preview_id/plan_digest seam preserved; no automatic retries. UI-only; no backend/schema/dependency changes.
